entities.observe: A thin man with a hazel stick in each hand, laying them side by side against the light.

entities.locked_toast: Sacks stacked low and a season coming for them. Lifting them above the flood line is work, and work is a Skill you either have or you don't.
entities.observe: Grain sacks stacked at ankle height on a shed floor, with the river three weeks out.

basic_cleaning.toast: [Basic Cleaning] — You clear the shed floor and stack every sack up off the boards. The count comes right the moment anyone can see all of it at once.

basic_cooking.toast: [Basic Cooking] — You feed the flood crew out of the mill's own pot, and they work the shed twice over for it. The count comes right in the doing.

entities._comment: encounter_when ARMS the fight on the quest start; present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters, so the corner stands visible and inert until then (the seal_warden_alcove pattern) and answers a plain interact with gate_closed_toast. Interact-only (no trigger_radius) -- the mill is a working interior and an ambush on the way to the tallyman would cross every TALK/HELP canonical. on_victory is an Array so the route counter is the only thing banked.
entities.gate_closed_toast: Something has been at the sacks in that corner. Nobody here has called it a problem yet, and it is not your count to go digging in.
entities.observe: Chaff scattered wide, sacks opened low down, and something breathing behind the last row.
A ladder down into a pit of black water, with the wheel standing still in it and the sluice pinned shut against the season.
entities.toast: The pinned sluice carries three seasons of high-water scratches, and each one sits higher than the last.

entities.observe: A shelf set higher on the wall than any shelf needs to be, with notches and years cut into the post beside it.
entities.toast: Somebody has cut a notch for every flood since before the village had a headman, and built the shelf a hand above the worst of them.

entities.observe: A bundle of split hazel sticks hung on a nail, each notched down one edge.
entities.toast: Split tallies. One half stays with the mill, one half goes home with the household, and neither can be altered alone.

floor_layers._pick: Same cool dark-plank swatch the Riverfarm longhouse picked out of Interior_Walls_01 ([12,21]/[13,21]/[12,22]/[13,22], rgb~87,64,49) -- one region, one interior floor language, and footstep-wood stays honest for a timber mill floor.
